rejected_routes.reason: Rejected on conceptual grounds: the papers treat thermodynamic consequence globally and conditionally over packaging fibers, not as independent stratum pressure systems.
Rejected because direct within-fiber root/profile separation is not paper-native and is unsupported on the audited shell.

theorem_statement_short: On the canonical hybrid object over the audited shell, the paper-native thermodynamic consequence route is conditional pressure disintegration: the global T0 cocycle pressure decomposes nontrivially over T1 packaging fibers, so T0 is not sufficient for the packaged future in the audited thermodynamic sense.

lemmas.statement_short: Persistent packaged fibers are well-defined theorem objects on the canonical hybrid object across the audited shell.

lemmas.label: compatibility with T0 cocycle pressure
lemmas.statement_short: The package-conditioned disintegration refines the closed T0 cocycle pressure because it uses the same thermodynamic base observable and conditions it on packaging fibers.

lemmas.label: nontrivial package-conditioned gap
lemmas.statement_short: The weighted package-conditioned pressure gap is nontrivial on the audited shell.

lemmas.label: insufficiency via conditional disintegration
lemmas.statement_short: A nontrivial package-conditioned pressure gap witnesses that T0 is insufficient for the packaged future on the audited shell.

lemmas.label: thermodynamic consequence relation between T0 and T1
lemmas.statement_short: The strict extension from T0 to T1 has a thermodynamic consequence because the T0 pressure decomposes nontrivially over T1 packaging fibers.

lemmas.label: hybrid pressure/root consequence theoremlet
